name: Close
one_liner: Close (close.com) sales CRM with a REST API for leads, contacts, opportunities and activities.
auth_notes: API key via HTTP Basic (key as username, empty password); OAuth 2.0 apps get all.full_access offline_access scopes only. Webhooks signed with HMAC sha256 (close-sig-hash).
access_notes: API keys from Settings > Developer > API Keys within a Close account (plan/trial requirement not stated on fetched pages). OAuth apps are Private by default; making them Public requires review by Close. Dev org via support email per first pass.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API keys and private OAuth apps work; serving arbitrary Close customers via OAuth needs Close review to make the app Public. OAuth scope is full access only.

needs_human_reason: Trial or plan requirement for API key not verified.

evidence.quote: Click **Make Public** and submit for review.
All OAuth applications are granted the `all.full_access offline_access` scopes
The MCP server URL is https://mcp.close.com/mcp
The maximum number of webhook subscriptions per organization is 40.

disputes.why: First pass gave the docs page; docs state the actual MCP server URL.
Public OAuth apps need submission and review; private apps do not.
Multi-customer OAuth requires Close approval; scopes are full-access only.
Key is sent via HTTP Basic; webhooks HMAC-signed.
